mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_user_setting (user_id, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO recommendation_batch (user_id, mode, algorithm_version, signal_count, source_fingerprint, generated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mode}, #{algorithmVersion}, #{signalCount}, #{sourceFingerprint}, #{generatedAt}, #{expiresAt})

INSERT INTO recommendation_item (batch_id, user_id, book_id, rank_no, total_score, content_score, collaborative_score, quality_score, exploration_score, source_type, reason) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{rankNo}, #{totalScore}, #{contentScore}, #{collaborativeScore}, #{qualityScore}, #{explorationScore}, #{sourceType}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT ri.id AS item_id, b.id AS book_id, b.name, b.author, b.category, b.cover, b.description, b.available_count, ri.source_type, ri.reason FROM recommendation_item ri JOIN book b ON b.id = ri.book_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ri.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY ri.rank_no ASC

SELECT id, batch_id, user_id, book_id, rank_no, total_score, content_score, collaborative_score, quality_score, exploration_score, source_type, reason FROM recommendation_item WHERE id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ri.id, ri.batch_id, ri.user_id, ri.book_id, ri.rank_no, ri.total_score, ri.content_score, ri.collaborative_score, ri.quality_score, ri.exploration_score, ri.source_type, ri.reason FROM recommendation_item ri JOIN recommendation_batch rb ON rb.id = ri.batch_id WHERE ri.user_id = #{userId} AND ri.book_id = #{bookId} AND rb.generated_at >= #{since} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recommendation_event re WHERE re.item_id = ri.id AND re.event_type = 'EXPOSE' ) ORDER BY ri.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_event (user_id, item_id, event_type, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{eventType}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recommendation_batch WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND generated_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.version, b.name, b.author, b.publisher, b.category, b.cover, b.description, b.total_count, b.available_count, b.create_time, COALESCE(f.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE(br.borrow_count, 0) AS borrow_count, COALESCE(rv.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(rv.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating FROM book b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM book_favorite GROUP BY book_id ) f ON f.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_record GROUP BY book_id ) br ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM book_review WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY book_id ) rv ON rv.book_id = b.id WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY b.id

SELECT b.id AS book_id, CASE WHEN f.book_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS favorite_count, COALESCE(br.borrow_count, 0) AS borrow_count, COALESCE(br.active_borrow_count, 0) AS active_borrow_count, COALESCE(rv.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(rv.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, GREATEST( COALESCE(f.latest_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(br.latest_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(rv.latest_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') ) AS latest_interaction_time FROM book b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, MAX(create_time) AS latest_time FROM book_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY book_id ) f ON f.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_borrow_count, MAX(borrow_time) AS latest_time FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY book_id ) br ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating, MAX(create_time) AS latest_time FROM book_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 GROUP BY book_id ) rv ON rv.book_id = b.id WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND (f.book_id IS NOT NULL OR br.book_id IS NOT NULL OR rv.book_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY b.id

SELECT bf.user_id, bf.book_id FROM book_favorite bf JOIN user u ON u.id = bf.user_id JOIN book b ON b.id = bf.book_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND u.account_status = 0 AND u.is_login = 0 AND bf.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT peer.user_id FROM book_favorite own JOIN book_favorite peer ON peer.book_id = own.book_id WHERE own.user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY bf.user_id, bf.book_id
